text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have some time on my hands, so I head
towards the track to get a
head start on
preparing for today's training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-s-stand up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmm, no good at all... One more time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! B-B-Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! B-B-Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I-I'm sorry. I figured you wouldn't
come for a bit longer, so I was
practicing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... the class greeting.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's my turn tomorrow. So... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no! It's not like that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not the best person for the
job... but if it's for my class,
then I always
try my best.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I write our class journal all the way to
the margins... And I keep the
chalkboard
clean, even if it means I have to jump to
reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm really, really bad at the class
greeting...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's hard for me to speak up... And when I
get nervous, my voice turns
all funny.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You will, Big Brother? You mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You will, Big Sister? You mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We find an empty classroom to practice
Rice's class greeting.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths... Okay, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-s-s-stand up! B-bow! Swit dwown... Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'm sho shorry. I bwit my twongue!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry for being such a failure.
Even
with you helping me out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry for being such a failure.
Even
with you helping me out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There's no hope for me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mhm... Exactly! I can't give up here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... may be hopeless,
but that doesn't mean
I want to stay like this!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-one more try. I'll nail it this time,
Big
Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-one more try. I'll nail it this time,
Big
Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I can do this... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stand up! Bow! Big Brother, thanks so
much for helping me yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stand up! Bow! Big Sister, thanks so much
for helping me yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Wow... When I'm with you, I feel
like I can change myself for
the better,
one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Wow... When I'm with you, I feel
like I can change myself for
the better,
one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haha, hehehe! I think I can go the extra
mile in today's training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drip...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep?! That's cold! Wh-what th—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaa?! But it was sunny just a moment
ago!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... it's all my fault.
I'm the only reason
why it would suddenly start
raining!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Waaah, I'm so sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush to comfort Rice Shower, whose
torrent of tears threatens to rival
Mother
Nature's own.
